scope: Bounded normal MCU fault/recovery -> 0x3c payload -> Frank payload boundary -> prepublish queue. Synthetic model only.
note: Every contract below was established by a PRIOR read-only code audit. This directory adds no new firmware-byte evidence; it joins existing layers and adds a per-row provenance ledger. Source hashes are in SOURCE_MANIFEST.json.

contracts.statement: 0801d7dc does not write the destination on DRDY false, SPI/mode/receive-CRC failure or ready mask 0; on CRC+ready it overwrites only ready channels and then backs up 32B; age<8 short-circuits by copying the object backup to the destination.
080233f4 copies the then-current into the ADC queue and every fifth row also stores 48B IMU; it does not check this read's DRDY/CRC or a success sequence number, and has no sampling-active guard.
contracts.modeled_as: TracedSampling.snapshot copies current unconditionally when active; provenance ledger retained per channel

contracts.statement: main 0x3c send looks only at mode and queue counts (ADC>=5, IMU>=1), not at sampling active; therefore a batch that was already complete before stop can still be consumed afterwards, and sub-threshold residue does not disappear on stop.
contracts.modeled_as: TracedSampling.take_normal_batch has no active check; scenario stop_with_residual_batch

contracts.statement: 0x29 stop sets active=0 and calls the timer setter(0,0,0) without clearing current, IMU values, software queues or diagnostic counters. 0x28 start pops both software queues, resets phase, sets active=1 and syncs/drains, but does NOT reset shared current or IMU.
contracts.modeled_as: TracedSampling.stop/start with queues_unchanged and current_unchanged assertions

contracts.statement: 08027008 whole-device reinit saves active, stops the setter, clears per-device objects (including ADC backup and IMU object) but NOT the whole SamplingState/current region; it calls start (and its queue clear) only if the saved active was non-zero.
contracts.modeled_as: TracedSampling.reinitialize with prior_active branch; scenarios reinit_while_active / reinit_while_stopped

contracts.statement: The 0x3c / 0x39 payloads do not carry a per-read CRC/ready sequence, a freshness flag or a source id; main 0x39 reads caches when the device is enabled without a per-segment freshness or CRC-valid bit.
contracts.modeled_as: freshness_marker_in_payload=False and crc_marker_in_payload=False on every emitted packet

contracts.statement: 0027e7b0 computes N=floor((payload_len-8-48)/64) without requiring a 64-byte remainder; reads BE32 tick, BE16 flags, BE16 frequency; 376 bytes yields 5 ADC rows and a 48B IMU block.

frequency=0 writes the header fields into the coroutine-local object and marks them present, then logs and exits without entering the per-row mapper/count update. frequency>0 uses integer step 1000/frequency and calls mapper 0021a5c0 with check/update=1 and tick=header_tick+row_index*step; owner+0x3c80 increments per decoded row. No upper bound or equality with configured 500 is checked.
contracts.modeled_as: FrankDecoder early_exit / row_ticks / mapper_rows / count_0x3c80; scenario frequency_zero_at_host

contracts.statement: Each decoded ADC row first copies the 0x7fffffff sentinel template and only writes the enabled groups; disabled fields are NOT the previous row's values. This branch does not inspect sample freshness.

The raw-data JS queue is a ring with N=17, capacity 16; the full check occurs BEFORE subject/body copy, so a rejected new message never overwrites the old head. On enqueue failure the raw submitter logs, frees the temporary copy and advances its own logger counter with no local retry.

core is handled first; js_Publish==0 frees the head and rotates the round-robin start; non-zero keeps the head, clears the connection, waits about 1s and re-scans. Worker running flag 0 returns immediately with no queue drain; 00189bb0 shows no per-item free or index reset.

Encoding -> Frank prepublish queue -> NATS raw_mem discard-old -> uploader/cloud are distinct stages; the prepublish 'reject new when full' is not the same as NATS discard-old, and logger sequence numbers are not sample/NATS/uploader sequence numbers.
contracts.modeled_as: This model stops at the prepublish queue; RESULTS.json scope_limits lists the omitted stages
